particles.notes: Golden bokeh particles — primary choice for divine/sacred scenes
Warm ember/rising particles — slow drift, good for penance/longing scenes

grain.notes: Mid-gray noise texture, 1920x1080 native — applied globally to every scene, not mood-conditional. Task 2.11: uses overlay blend, NOT grainmerge — grainmerge darkens mid-tones, overlay preserves scene brightness.
